title: Doktor KosMed public-site accessibility review
target_standard: WCAG 2.2 AA (targeted checks; not a conformance claim)
scope: Localized public-site service pages rendered by Vite and Nitro
Skip-link focus order, visibility, target focus, and accessibility-tree roles/names
method: Source review plus dedicated Playwright keyboard and Axe E2E checks using synthetic public-site data.

findings.observation: The localized skip link is the first page control, becomes visible on focus, and moves focus to the single main landmark. Playwright exposes its localized name, the named navigation, and main landmark in the browser accessibility tree. The owner manually confirmed the visible link and focus transfer.
findings.verification_needed: The exact live Narrator announcement was not recorded; broader assistive-technology testing remains necessary before any WCAG conformance claim.

findings.observation: The localized service catalog on Vite and Nitro and the localized Vite error state passed the configured Axe rules in Chromium and emulated Mobile Chrome.
findings.verification_needed: This route sample and rule set do not evaluate every WCAG 2.2 AA criterion.

limitations: The owner reported the visible link and focus transfer, but the exact live Narrator speech output was not recorded; accessibility-tree assertions do not replace broader assistive-technology testing.
Only selected public catalog/error states were audited; this is not a complete WCAG 2.2 AA audit.
Local Firefox and WebKit Playwright binaries are absent; the dedicated CI spec runs only in Chromium, so cross-browser behavior remains unverified.
Mobile Chrome used an emulated viewport, not a physical device.

mobile_reflow_follow_up.scope: Targeted mobile public header, catalog filters and keyboard bypass, after catalog data is ready.

live_baseline.chrome: On /ru/services, Tab reached the menu before the language switch despite the opposite visual order. The open menu covered the center of a focused service link.
live_baseline.firefox_text_only_200_percent: Brand text extended to 403 CSS px and the open menu extended its link text left of the viewport on the measured public catalog pages.

mobile_reflow_follow_up.fix: Align mobile DOM and visual order, let the expanded native disclosure occupy normal flow, and wrap brand and menu text at narrow widths.

checks: Actual Tab order and visible focus
Menu opens and leaves subsequent focused controls exposed
Brand and menu text fits viewport
Skip link transfers focus to main
Catalog query and keyboard reset restore results and focus
Sampled reduced-motion scroll and animation settings
isolated_vite.teardown: Owned browser profiles and loopback services stopped.

mobile_reflow_follow_up.regression: The existing Playwright accessibility spec now exercises real forward and reverse Tab through the mobile services header and catalog for both locales and Vite/Nitro. It tests that the open menu does not cover the focused search control or service link.
remaining: Live Narrator announcements and native Safari
Desktop text-only enlargement is tracked in desktop_reflow_follow_up.
Full WCAG 2.2 AA audit and full staging validation

loading_focus_follow_up.runtime: Isolated Vite using synthetic catalog responses
loading_focus_follow_up.method: Hold the required catalog response. Press Tab and Enter to focus main while loading, then release the response and read the active element and the original node identity.

baseline.observation: After success, the browser retained #main-content, focused the body and returned to the skip link on the next Tab.

loading_focus_follow_up.fix: Keep the shared header, native skip link and main landmark mounted across request states for a single pathname.
loading_focus_follow_up.regression: Playwright holds a real synthetic catalog response in both Vite locales and checks the same focused main before and after success, including the next Tab stop.
remaining: Full WCAG 2.2 AA and staging acceptance

desktop_reflow_follow_up.scope: Desktop public header on the Russian and Uzbek services routes.

live_baseline.observation: Navigation or language links and their focused targets extended beyond the visible viewport.

desktop_reflow_follow_up.fix: Let the header groups and desktop links wrap in DOM order. Allow long text to break and leave room for focus outlines.

checks: Native Firefox text-only enlargement doubled calibration text, button text and route brand text while viewport, fixed box width and DPR stayed constant.
The whole header fit with no horizontal overflow, clipped controls or clipped text fragments.
Actual Tab reached the skip link, brand, five navigation links and language switch with visible, exposed focus.
isolated_vite.teardown: Owned browser profile, synthetic API and Vite listeners were removed.

desktop_reflow_follow_up.regression: The Playwright spec doubles computed header-link font sizes at 960 CSS px in Vite and Nitro for each locale and checks actual Tab, visible labels and target bounds. Existing mobile keyboard checks cover the native menu.

production_follow_up.checks: Calibrated native Firefox zoom doubled text widths with stable viewport, device pixel ratio and fixed box. At both zoom levels, the header had zero horizontal overflow and actual Tab reached the skip link, brand, five menu links and language switch with exposed focus.
production_follow_up.teardown: The disposable Firefox profile was deleted.

remaining: Actual screen-reader speech, native Safari and physical devices
Full WCAG 2.2 AA and staging acceptance

published_catalog_follow_up.deployment_identity_check: Vercel resolved the Production alias to this READY deployment before and after the sweep.

scope.source: All 14 URLs in the public sitemap, seven in each of ru and uz-Latn.
scope.narrow_profile: Chrome with its default user agent, emulated touch input and device scale factor 2.

computed_contrast.method: Calculate WCAG relative luminance from effective browser colors and their composited solid backgrounds. Compare the unrounded ratios to the thresholds.

reduced_motion.scope: Visible public-site content and generated pseudo-elements in the scanned states.

published_catalog_follow_up.procedure: Read the sitemap, open each URL in a fresh Chrome page at each viewport with reduced motion enabled, check HTTP 200 and document language, run the listed Axe tags, then press Tab and Enter to verify focus. Open the menu with Enter on both narrow home pages and run Axe again. Keep browser requests on the site's own frontend and public API.
limitations: A separate Pixel 7 Chrome emulation profile received connection resets for all 14 document requests and yielded no scans.
Contrast samples cover default states and the visible skip-link focus outline. Hover, forced colors and Vite dark mode were outside this measurement.
Exact screen-reader speech, physical devices, native Safari and complete WCAG conformance remain unverified.

forced_colors_keyboard_follow_up.browser: Headless Chrome 157.0.8103.79 on Windows, using Playwright.

forced_colors.outlines: Computed 3 CSS px solid outlines on sampled links and filter controls and native auto outlines on main and the mobile disclosure.

checks: Loaded each route with HTTP 200 and the expected document language in a fresh browser context for each viewport and color mode.
First Tab revealed the skip link. Enter focused main and set the target fragment. Subsequent Tab reached the search, category selector and reset control.
Keyboard focus reached the desktop navigation. In the narrow layout Enter opened the native disclosure, Tab reached its first link, and Shift+Tab followed by Enter closed the menu.
Checked :focus-visible, viewport intersection and computed outline contrast against the adjacent solid surface. In the light comparison also measured the hovered navigation text.
limitations: An initial forced-colors attempt encountered connection resets. The recorded complete sweeps used a fresh browser process with QUIC and HTTP/2 disabled.
Measurements cover the browser's emulated light forced-colors palette and these two routes. Dark palettes, physical devices, native Safari and actual screen-reader speech remain separate checks.
No new Axe scan or full WCAG 2.2 AA or staging acceptance was performed in these sweeps. Previous Axe results remain in their original audit section.

synthetic_dark_forced_colors_follow_up.checks: The first Tab revealed the localized skip link. Enter focused main and set the target fragment. Subsequent Tabs reached the breadcrumb and catalog controls. All samples matched focus-visible and intersected the viewport.
synthetic_dark_forced_colors_follow_up.limits: Contrast ratios use computed colors at sampled states. The automatic main outlines have computed visibility and style observations. Speech, native system high contrast, physical devices, native Safari and full WCAG conformance remain unverified.

native_text_zoom_follow_up.method: Calibrate with HTML text and button text widths while fixed CSS width, viewport and DPR stay constant. Verify doubling again on each actual route. Compare DOM text geometry and exercise natural Tab through main/footer, the skip link and catalog filter/reset.

focus_follow_up.description: The initial center-only probe flagged six scenarios. A diagnostic repeat confirmed that candidate centers could fall below the viewport even when parts of the same targets remained exposed, and stopped on an immediate first-Tab check. A separate repeat ensured initial document focus and sampled viewport intersections. The order, exposed target area, :focus-visible selector, and skip activation passed in its measured scenarios.

native_text_zoom_follow_up.teardown: Temporary Firefox profiles and fixture listeners removed.
native_text_zoom_follow_up.remaining: Rendered focus outline, native select popup, other zoom modes and configurations, screen-reader output and the full WCAG audit.

text_spacing.method: Compare baseline with four CSS overrides using !important. Apply line-height 1.5, paragraph margin-block-end 2em, letter-spacing 0.12em and word-spacing 0.16em. Check the computed ratios, rendered text rectangles, clipping ancestors, document scroll width, and menu and catalog interactions.
text_spacing.limits: The layout check uses text rectangles. Painted glyphs and the native select popup remain unverified.

target_size_geometry.method: In touch-emulated contexts, sample DOM rectangles with the mobile menu closed and open. Exclude hidden or disabled candidates and descendants of closed details outside its first summary. Count candidates with a client rectangle at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels. For smaller candidates, check whether a centered circle 24 CSS pixels in diameter intersects another candidate rectangle or undersized candidate circle.
target_size_geometry.limits: Counts include repeated observations across page states. This sampler compares DOM geometry. Separate hit point observations are recorded in mobile_pointer_dispatch. Full hit-region boundaries and painted clipping remain unverified.

desktop_text_spacing.method: Compare baseline and four spacing overrides on the same 14 synthetic RU/UZ routes. Verify computed spacing, DOM text geometry and document scroll width. Test the first Tab and Enter to focus main, plus catalog filtering, empty state, reset and search focus.
desktop_text_spacing.limits: The sampler compares DOM geometry at three light-mode desktop widths. It does not inspect painted glyphs, the native select popup or spoken output.

mobile_pointer_dispatch.method: Compare the browser hit target at the center and four interior points of each visible client rectangle after scrolling it into view. In the same contexts dispatch a coordinate tap at the center of the largest fragment of each small control and record the trusted touchstart target. Suppress activation only during these bulk probes. Use normal taps for menu toggle and catalog reset checks.
mobile_pointer_dispatch.limits: These sampled points in touch-emulated Chromium and Firefox do not measure full hit-region boundaries or the native select popup. Physical devices and WCAG conformance remain open.

synthetic_text_spacing_target_size_follo.limitations: Evidence covers the listed synthetic pages and sampled states. Full WCAG 2.2 AA, screen-reader speech, native mobile browsers, physical devices and other desktop configurations remain open.
